title: Injectivity of the full matching trace
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $r>0$, and consider the complete $2r$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. The map sending a perfect matching to its full greedy pairing trace, starting from all vertices and making $rk$ pairings, is injective.
